title: Private Doors-Off Kauai Helicopter: Ultimate Waterfalls & Canyons
overview: The excitement of a helicopter tour can quickly turn to disappointment when you are seated in the middle. Not on this private tour where every seat is a window seat. You'll get excellent views of Kauai as you soar through the sky over Manawaiopuna Falls, the Olokele Canyon, Waimea Canyon, Na Pali coast, and Wai'ale'ale crater.

title: 60-Minute Guided Doors-Off Helicopter Tour in Kauai
overview: Get those drone views of Hawaii’s “Garden Isle”—but get them yourself, in an open-door helicopter. With no rear middle seats, you and your crew will take to the skies for nearly an hour, flying above lush canyons, wild cliffs, and the wettest spot on Earth. Led by a trained firefighting pilot, you’ll get a fast-paced-yet-awe-inducing adventure, and you’ll nab some of the most gorgeous views on the planet. Fly above Kauai with a trained pilot at the helm See waterfalls from Jurassic Park, the Na Pali Coast, and more exquisite sights Get open-door access to the island's best views Limited to 4 guests, you'll get an intimate flight experience

title: Hughes 500 4-Passenger Doors-Off Helicopters
overview: Get those drone views of Hawaii’s “Garden Isle”—but get them yourself, in an open-door helicopter. With no rear middle seats, you and your crew will take to the skies for nearly an hour, flying above lush canyons, wild cliffs, and the wettest spot on Earth. Led by a trained firefighting pilot, you’ll get a fast-paced-yet-awe-inducing adventure, and you’ll nab some of the most gorgeous views on the planet.
itineraryStops: Na Pali Coast State Wilderness Park

title: Kauai Eco Adventure Helicopter Tour
overview: To fully appreciate the beauty of Hawaii’s ‘Garden Isle,’ take to the skies above Kauai on a helicopter tour in a new Eurocopter Eco-Star. Soar over the island’s diverse terrain, from rain-soaked Mount Waialeale and the waterfalls of Waiapuna to the dry red ravine of Waimea Canyon and the breathtaking emerald spires of the Na Pali Coast. A two-way radio to communicate with the pilot and expansive viewing glass add to the unforgettable flight.

title: The Secret Waterfall Private tour with photos
overview: This private tour gets you closer to some of the most stunning waterfalls on Kauai than would be possible alone or in a big group. The exact location depends upon your party's preferences and abilities but the tour can be as challenging as you wish. Your guide is a professional photographer and videographer so you will have someone with you to capture memories to cherish.

title: Kauai Highlights Small Group Tour - A journey to the Canyon & more
overview: This full-day guided excursion takes you to 8 of Kauai’s gorgeous spots by air-conditioned vehicle, ideal for a shore excursion. Drive through the south and west sides of the island, taking in a mix of scenic views and an opportunity to try and buy local products. Your guide will share the legends and stories of the places you stop by, including the renowned Waimea Canyon, the powerful Spouting Horn, Kauai Coffee Company, and more. Take the day off from driving and let us show you Kauai through local eyes.

title: Kauai Canyon Explorer: Private Tour Featuring Waimea & Kokee
overview: Nicknamed the “Garden Isle,” Kauai is the oldest of Hawaii’s main islands, giving it time to become the lush oasis it is today. On this tour, you’ll experience its western wonders, from colorful Waimea Canyon and the 800-foot Waipoo Falls to the largest coffee orchard in the country. You’ll feed chickens, cross historic swinging bridges, taste local foods, and walk away understanding Hawaii’s greatest legends.

title: Kauai's South & East Small-Group Tour: Legends & Waterfalls
overview: The Kauai legends, waterfalls, and geysers tour mixes stunning natural sites with storytelling across the island's south and east sides. Take the day off from driving and relax while a local guide shares Hawaiian legends at waterfalls, river lookouts, and the Spouting Horn blowhole. Small-group routing keeps the experience intimate as you travel by air-conditioned vehicle with live narration.

title: Private Waimea Canyon Tour
overview: On your private tour of Kauai, you'll see the magnificent Waimea Canyon and places the big bus tours can't take you to. You'll enjoy great photo ops of Waipo'o Falls, admire a beautiful vista at Kalalau Lookout and visit the Poipu Beach resort area to see the Spouting Horn, sea turtles and perhaps a Hawaiian Monk seal! With a knowledgeable guide, you'll also visit attractions like the Kauai Coffee Company and the Captain Cook monument. Hotel pick-up from the Wailua, Poipu, Lihue and Kapaa resorts. \* Price displayed is based on a party of four to six passengers

title: Ni'ihau and Na Pali Coast Snorkel Boat Tour
overview: The Na Pali coast may be 17 miles of pure “Garden Isle” splendor, but there’s even more to explore beyond its 4,000-foot cliffs. On this tour, you’ll go for 60 miles of discovery, from the coast to Kaulakahi Channel to Lehua Crater, the “Forbidden Island” of Ni’ihau, and beyond. Along the way, you’ll spot dolphins, snorkel amongst reefs, and, of course, sip and sit back, relishing in the adventure.
itineraryStops: Na Pali Coast State Wilderness Park

title: Nā Pali Coast Zodiac Raft Sea Caves Expedition on Kauai
overview: Fly across the ocean on an exhilarating guided Zodiac raft ride along the gorgeous Na Pali coast. The raft’s small size allows you to get into hard-to-reach sea caves, plus you’ll ogle pristine beaches, gushing waterfalls, and sheer cliffs. This ocean adventure isn’t for the light-hearted, but the Zodiac rafts provide a thrilling and memorable way to explore this magnificent coastline from the water, as your captain and crew ensure your safety.

title: Kauai Adventure: Kayak & Hike to Secret Falls with Expert Guide
overview: Explore the natural beauty of Kauai on a 5-hour tour that combines a lovely kayaking trip with an moderately easy hike to Uluwehi Falls, also known as Secret Falls. Your experienced guide provides a paddling lesson and guided kayak tour in the Wailua River Valley, following gorgeous waterways through the lush Kauai landscape. Then hop out of your kayaks and take a 45-minute hike to Secret Falls where you can cool off in the clear waters before returning to the Wailua marina the way you came.

title: Kauai Waimea Canyon, Wailua River Boat and Fern Grotto Tour
overview: Experience the natural wonders of Kauai on this full-day guided tour, featuring a scenic Wailua River cruise to the lush Fern Grotto and breathtaking views of Waimea Canyon. Visit iconic spots like Opaekaa Falls and the Kauai Coffee Estate, where you can sample locally grown coffee. With a knowledgeable guide, air-conditioned transport, and plenty of photo stops, this tour offers a perfect blend of relaxation, history, and stunning landscapes.

title: Luau Kalamaku on Kauai with Manor House 4-Course Dinner & Show
overview: Enjoy an enchanted evening in Kauai with a gourmet dinner followed by one of the top-rated luaus on the island! Kick off the night with a Champagne reception and lei greeting at the historic Kilohana Plantation, then settle into a four-course meal of island favorites. After dinner, take in the mesmerizing Luau Kalamaku as dancers, fire-twirlers and musicians enact the story of the first Tahitian voyage to Hawaii. Your premier seat will provide a great view of all the vibrant action.

title: Koloa Zipline in Kauai
overview: Get a new perspective on Kauai as you soar through lush forests and over the Waita Reservoir on the island's longest ziplines. While cruising across the 8-track course near Koloa, hang on to the handlebars or try some more daring acrobatic stunts with the hands-free 'Flyin' Kauai'an' harness.
